description:
crates/kmux/tests/issue8_interactive_exit.rs:165 fails locally:

  left:  "teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454:/home/.../crates/kmux"
  right: "CLAUDETITLE"

The test spawns a real shell in a PTY and expects the OSC title it wrote (CLAUDETITLE) to stick. On the maintainer's box the interactive shell's own prompt writes OSC 0/2 on every prompt redraw, so the shell's title lands AFTER the test's and wins. Environment-dependent, not a kmux regression — the assertion races the user's shell rc.

Fix direction: spawn the child with a rc-less non-interactive shell (or set a stub PS1 with no OSC escape), so nothing but the test writes the title. Do NOT just relax the assertion — the OSC path is the thing under test.

Found while running the full workspace gate for bd-8sh (nucleo panic fix). Pre-existing: kmux has no dependency on kopitiam-neovim, so that fix cannot have caused it.
title: kmux test osc_title_rename_is_applied_when_allow_set_title_is_on fails on maintainer's box
